entries.displayName: Neon DB Admin Universal Database Workbench
entries.description: Browser-based database management tool and MySQL Workbench-style visual ER diagram designer for SQLite (WASM), MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1, and LibSQL.
representativeQueries: Open and edit SQLite database files offline in the browser with WebAssembly
Connect to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, or Cloudflare D1 through a CORS-enabled proxy
Reverse engineer database tables into a Crow's Foot ER diagram and export SQL DDL
